evals.prompt: Audit the architecture boundaries of this project
evals.expected_output: A full report listing all boundary violations — import violations, security term leakage in generic code, security content in generic prompts, and topology logic in plugins. Should find real violations like query/api/app.py importing SecurityDomainPlugin, core/application hardcoding CVE regex, etc.

evals.prompt: Check if any security concepts leaked into the prompt templates that should be generic
evals.expected_output: A focused report on prompt templates. Should find CVE-XXXX placeholders in prompts/operations/assess.j2 and decomposition.j2. Should confirm prompts/domains/secbench/ is excluded from the scan.

evals.prompt: Are there any files outside plugins/ and bootstrap/composition.py that import from the security plugin?
evals.expected_output: Should find query/api/app.py importing SecurityDomainPlugin and infrastructure/adapters/secbench_runtime.py importing from plugins.security. Should clearly state these are violations of the single-composition-root rule.
